name: standup
description: /standup: click Generate and get a written standup of everything you got done today, grouped by project, from your local Claude Code sessions.

model.title: Model
model.description: Writes each session's summary. Haiku 5.5 is the default and the cheapest. Sonnet 5.5 writes sharper bullets for about 20x the cost. Opus and Fable cost more still.

effort.title: Effort
effort.description: How hard the model thinks. Default low, which is plenty for short summaries. Higher effort costs more output tokens.

folder.title: Save folder
folder.description: Each generated standup is also saved here as YYYY-MM-DD.md. A blank value uses ~/standups. Type off to save nothing.

maxSessions.title: Max sessions
maxSessions.description: Default 40. The most recently active sessions are summarized first; older ones that day are skipped. A blank value uses the default.
